2609.03806.title: SVG-Score: Human-Aligned Evaluation of Text-to-SVG Generation
2609.03806.paper_summary: Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) generation is attracting increasing attention as generative models improve in expressiveness and controllability. Progress, however, is held back by the lack of domain-specific evaluation protocols: current practice relies on metrics designed for natural images, most notably CLIPScore, which was never trained on vector graphics and aligns only partially with human judgment. We introduce \textbf{\ours}, a human-aligned evaluation framework for text-to-SVG generation. Through controlled caption and image perturbations, we first show that CLIP-based scores barely react to the errors SVG generators actually make, such as wrong colors, counts, and spatial relations, and that off-the-shelf Vision-Language Model (VLM) judges, while more sensitive, respond unevenly across error types and SVG styles. We then introduce a human-annotated dataset for \textit{Semantic Alignment}, measuring how faithfully a generated SVG reflects its caption. Building on it, we develop two complementary evaluators: CLIP scorers adapted to vector graphics and then aligned to human preferences, for fast large-scale evaluation, and a VLM judge trained with supervised fine-tuning and reward-shaped reinforcement learning, for more expressive and interpretable assessment. Using both, we benchmark major open-source, commercial, and optimization-based SVG generators on an independent caption set.
2609.03806.paper_summary_zh: 可擴展向量圖形（SVG）生成正受到越來越多的關注，因為生成模型在表達能力和可控性方面不斷改進。然而，進展受到缺乏特定領域評估協議的限制：目前的做法依賴於為自然圖像設計的指標，最著名的是 CLIPScore，該指標從未在向量圖形上進行過訓練，並且僅部分與人類判斷對齊。我們介紹了 \textbf{\ours}，這是一個與人類對齊的文本到 SVG 生成的評估框架。通過控制標題和圖像擾動，我們首先顯示 CLIP 基礎的分數幾乎對 SVG 生成器實際犯的錯誤（例如錯誤的顏色、數量和空間關係）沒有反應，而現成的視覺-語言模型（VLM）評判者雖然更敏感，但在錯誤類型和 SVG 風格之間的反應不均勻。然後，我們介紹了一個人類標註的數據集，用於 \textit{語義對齊}，測量生成的 SVG 在多大程度上忠實於其標題。基於此，我們開發了兩個互補的評估器：適應於向量圖形的 CLIP 評分器，然後與人類偏好對齊，以便快速進行大規模評估，以及一個經過監督微調和獎勵形狀強化學習訓練的 VLM 評判者，以便進行更具表達性和可解釋性的評估。使用這兩者，我們在獨立的標題集上基準測試了主要的開源、商業和基於優化的 SVG 生成器。
